title: On the Metric Completion of Immersed Open Curves
summary: The completeness properties of spaces of immersed curves endowed with Sobolev-type reparametrization-invariant Riemannian metrics have been studied extensively in recent years. Whereas constant-coefficient metrics of large enough order on the space of closed curves are known to be complete, this is not the case for open curves. In this work, we characterize the metric completion of the space of real-valued immersed open curves with respect to these metrics.
